categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the renewable plastics industry, focusing on three main business segments: plastic recycling, plastic regeneration, and plastic utilization. Its product portfolio includes finished frames, decorative building materials, plastic particles, environmental protection equipment, and PET products. The company has developed a diversified product matrix with over 70% of revenue coming from high-value terminal products such as finished frames and decorative building materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including foam densification and compression equipment for plastic recycling, molecular chain repair and plastic modification for regenerated PS particles, and multi-layer co-extrusion technology for producing recycled plastic profiles and sheets. It also uses vacuum thermoforming for PET products and has developed proprietary equipment for efficient plastic foam volume reduction. The company emphasizes intelligent manufacturing with automation and digital transformation to improve efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include downstream industries such as home decoration, packaging, electronics, medical, and food packaging sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant sales in North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Japan. Its products are recognized by major international retailers and decoration product companies, targeting mid-to-high-end home decoration markets globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global operational footprint with production bases and subsidiaries in China (Shandong, Shanghai, Anhui, Jiangsu), Vietnam, Malaysia, Singapore, Hong Kong, and the United States. It maintains a global recycling network covering over 80 countries and has established direct sales channels in multiple regions including North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Oceania.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the entire plastic recycling supply chain, including upstream plastic waste collection and compression, midstream plastic regeneration into recycled particles, and downstream manufacturing of recycled plastic products. It integrates recycling equipment sales, raw material supply, and finished product sales, positioning itself as a vertically integrated player in the renewable plastics industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on expanding its product portfolio vertically into multiple plastic types (PE, PP, HDPE) and horizontally into multi-material resource recycling. It prioritizes R&D in plastic recycling equipment, high-quality regenerated particles, and innovative recycled plastic products. The company invests heavily in intelligent manufacturing, automation, and digital transformation, and collaborates with academic and industry partners to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of recycled plastic products (frames, building materials, particles, PET products) and recycling equipment. The company employs a direct sales model with both domestic and international customers, including retail and industrial clients. It also benefits from government subsidies and financial income from investments and currency exchange gains.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the renewable plastics recycling industry in China and globally, distinguished by its full industry chain integration and advanced technology. It competes with other plastic recycling and regeneration enterprises but holds competitive advantages in scale, technology, global supply chain, and diversified product offerings. The company maintains strong market positions in PS and PET recycled plastics sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved record revenue of approximately RMB 2.45 billion, a 19.41% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 195.65 million, a 15.22% decrease. Total assets grew 37.47% to RMB 4.02 billion, and shareholders' equity increased 7.76% to RMB 2.24 billion. The company has a workforce of 3,536 employees and continues to invest significantly in R&D, with expenditures representing about 4.28% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a unique value proposition by integrating the entire plastic recycling chain, providing high-quality recycled plastic materials and finished products with performance close to virgin materials but at lower cost. Its proprietary densification equipment reduces logistics costs, and its multi-layer co-extrusion and modification technologies enable environmentally friendly, durable, and aesthetically versatile products that replace traditional wood, stone, and metal materials. The company emphasizes sustainability, innovation, and global direct sales channels to deliver comprehensive solutions to customers.
